name: FadiMart

guardrails.positioning: Software for US convenience-store owners, including stores at gas stations.
guardrails.honest_message: Use plain English for store owners. Validate the actual workflow before advertising delivery, POS, fuel or payment features.
guardrails.canonical_traits: Cheetah spots and dark tear marks from eyes to muzzle; agile silhouette without fuel accessories.
guardrails.voice_style: Direct, useful and respectful of diverse family businesses.
guardrails.avoid: Cultural stereotypes; claims about fuel pumps, lottery, alcohol or tobacco compliance without verification.
